title: PingLens Trace
description: Continuous trace of one target: per-hop loss, latency and responding addresses from pinglens-exporter, which probes every hop every 2.5 seconds.

panels.title: Hops (selected time range)
panels.description: One row per TTL and responding address over the selected range. Loss is the TTL's share of probes without a reply; a router that rate-limits its ICMP errors shows loss that does not carry on to later hops. Last 2m is the mean RTT of the last two minutes.

panels.title: Path: responding IP per hop
panels.description: Which address answered at each TTL over time, colored by that TTL's loss in the step: green below 2%, yellow from 2%, red from 10%. Rows are TTL order; a new row at the same TTL is a path change. Loss is measured per TTL, so addresses sharing a TTL share its color. Red at one hop but not at later hops is ICMP rate limiting, not path loss.

panels.title: Destination latency and loss
panels.description: Mean RTT of the destination's replies, and the share of probes at the destination's TTLs without a reply.
